title: A turn whose only writes were media uploads gives the site's write lease back when it ends
steps: S1: Through the shipped bundle, a turn makes one media.upload through the Apply door and ends.
S2: A turn makes only a media.delete dry_run preview and ends.
S3: A turn ends while its lease is no longer its own; watch the release.
expect: S1: a lease release is sent for the session at turn end.
S2: no lease release is sent (the preview took none).
S3: no release is sent, the first try included.

selectors.code: site-call.mjs doorTakesLease (mirrors tracy-web sites/route.js changesSite), index.ts relayRaw leaseHolders, releaseSiteLease stillOurs

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: leaseHolders was recorded by makesReadsStale, which leaves out media.upload/media.delete, while the door takes the lease for them; the lease then held ~90 s after the turn
fence: The client records a lease holder by the door's own write rule

tests: 🔒 C3: a turn whose only write was a media upload gives the write lease back when it ends
🔒 C3: a media delete preview takes no lease, so the turn that only previewed releases none
🔒 C6: a lease release asks whether the lease is still this turn's before its FIRST send too
